purpose: Extends the MLS receive pipeline in device-sync.ts to drain the parked retry queue after successful ingest activity, capped by a per-event-per-epoch retry budget to prevent retry storms on permanently-undecryptable events.

public_api.name: useDeviceSync
public_api.signature: function useDeviceSync(client: MarmotClient | null, pubkey: string, relays: string[], signer: EventSigner): void
public_api.description: React hook owning the MLS receive pipeline. S6 extends the ingestGroupEventsRaw inner function to run a parked-queue drain when processed.size > 0, bounded by retryAttempts (MAX_RETRIES=3 per event per epoch). No change to the hook's external signature or return type.

owned_data: retryAttempts: Map<string, Map<string, number>> — effect-closure-scoped, keyed groupId → eventId → retry count within current epoch
MAX_RETRIES: 3 — constant, capped retries per event per epoch
dependencies_allowed: marmot.ingest-queue (read-only: snapshot, remove via existing code)
events_emitted: queue-drain with trigger: 'ingest-activity' — new trace event emitted when the drain fires on ingest activity
test_targets: src/marmot/device-sync.test.ts — new file: three AC-B-6 cases covering drain-on-ingest no-infinite-loop, epoch-reset semantics, per-group keying. Deviation from ingest-queue.test.ts justified because retryAttempts lives in device-sync.ts; surfaced per stories.json scope note.
